title: Rendering with a transparent background
text: To cut the subject out of the background, turn on transparent film. The world still lights the scene but is not drawn, and the output keeps an alpha channel. Save to a format with alpha such as PNG RGBA.

title: Colour management: view transforms, looks and exposure
text: The view transform turns scene light into display colour; AgX is the default and keeps bright highlights from clipping. Looks add contrast presets. Exposure shifts brightness in stops before the transform.

title: Motion blur
text: Motion blur smears moving things over the time the shutter is open. Turn it on and set the shutter length in frames; half a frame is a common film look.

title: Render sampling and noise
text: Each renderer averages several samples per pixel. Cycles uses path tracing samples; EEVEE uses anti-aliasing samples. Raise samples to reduce noise and jagged edges at the cost of render time.

title: Camera depth of field
text: Depth of field blurs what is in front of or behind the focus distance. A low f-stop gives a shallow, soft background that isolates a product.

title: Output resolution and aspect
text: Width and height set the frame size and aspect ratio; the percentage scales both for quick previews.

title: Frame rate
text: Frames per second decide how long each frame lasts in playback. 24, 25, 30 and 60 are common delivery rates.
